description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/try.t is 28 rows; six diverge and two of those are never produced:

  * "try { return } in :lvalue sub in scalar context" / "in list context"
    (never produced) -- NS:Lvalue subroutines [DEFERRED] (#930).
  * "try {} block is invisible to caller()" -- NS:`caller()` fidelity
    [DEFERRED -- task #233]: perl's try block does not create a frame.
  * "compiletime warnings" -- NS:Warnings-gated diagnostics (#221).
  * "Parse error for catch without (VAR)" -- NS:Error compatibility for
    invalid Perl input: perl rejects `catch { }` with no variable at COMPILE
    time.

So the file needs nothing of its own: it is four already-owned classes meeting
in one place.  This task exists so the rows have a single citable owner and so
that a future try/catch change re-reads them; close it when #930 and #233 move.
subject: The try/catch residue after #340: `try` must be invisible to caller(), must not be used in a :lvalue sub, and `catch` without (VAR) is a compile-time error (op/try.t, 6 rows)
